title: Hold a dealer's licence
what: Manufacture, sell or advertise prohibited weapons only under an approval from the Commissioner of Police or an exemption under s 12.

sources.title: Weapons Control Act 2001 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not: (a) bring into the Territory; or (b) cause to be brought or sent into the Territory; or (c) manufacture, sell or purchase; or (d) display or advertise for sale; or (e) possess, use or carry; a prohibited weapon except if permitted to do so by an exemption under section 12 or an approval
